about_the_game:
"Erase the words that consume the soul."

『Pain Pain Go Away!』 is a unique Typing x Adventure game where you step into the minds of troubled girls, erasing the painful "words" that haunt them.
Enter their subconscious, type away their traumas, and free them from their suffering.

◆ Gameplay

💡 Erase the trauma haunting the girl through typing!

  • Enter the subconscious and type away the "trauma words" that appear on screen.

  • As the attacks of words intensify, your typing skills and ability to stay calm will be put to the test!

  • By erasing these words, the deeper story within her heart will gradually unfold…

💡 Guide the girl’s story through counseling

  • It’s not just about typing—your choices and conversations also shape the outcome.

  • The deeper you delve into her mind, the more of her hidden story will be revealed.

◆ Story

You are a counselor at a small clinic.
Using the P2GA device, a revolutionary psychological therapy machine, you dive into your patients' subconscious and erase "trauma words" through typing, healing their wounded hearts.

One day, a young girl named Kokoromi visits your clinic, convinced that she has killed her mother.
What is the true nature of the "pain" lurking deep within her mind?
As you retrace her memories through typing, the hidden truth begins to surface.

◆ Features

🔹 Typing x Psychological Healing! A new kind of Typing Adventure
🔹 A deep, immersive narrative-driven experience
🔹 Multiple difficulty levels to match your typing skills
🔹 Beautiful, dreamlike visuals capturing the fragile emotions of the characters

The only way to save these wounded girls is with your typing skills.
Face the battle of words and emotions in "Pain Pain Go Away!"
